jobs.title: Senior Events and Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description_text:
About Viam 

Founded by Eliot Horowitz, co-founder and former CTO of MongoDB, Viam is a novel robotics engineering platform that lets you configure, control, and manage robots intuitively and quickly. We’re inspiring a generation of engineers to solve complicated automation problems with our uniquely powerful suite of software tools.

We’re a ~100-person company headquartered in New York City.

About the role

In office at our New York City headquarters, with travel to events in other cities.

At a Viam hackathon, teams of robotics application developers spend the event building projects on robot arms and other machines. Before the first team sits down, someone has booked the room, made sure the venue has power at every table and a network the robots can use, filled it with 50 to 100 developers, and made sure Viam’s mentors and staff know their roles, where to be, and when. That someone is you, and once the event starts, you keep it on time and help troubleshoot any problems that arise.

You'll run Viam's events program, and hackathons are one part of it. We've held them in person at our New York City headquarters and in San Francisco. The rest of the program is workshops and conferences, where we run a booth and demos. We run one to two hackathons a month and attend four to six conferences a year. jobs.title: Counsel, Government Contracts & Public Sector
jobs.description_text:
About Virtru:

While the rest of the security industry obsesses over locking data down to prevent it from being lost or stolen, we're doing something fundamentally different at Virtru. We're setting data free so that you can intentionally share it with others, but without sacrificing security, privacy, or control.

We've created both a suite of powerful data protection applications and an open platform that's sparking an ecosystem of innovation. Through the Trusted Data Format (TDF) open standard, we're not just protecting data; we're creating a new paradigm where security enables sharing rather than preventing it.

Think of us as the Android of data protection: a robust platform with an open core that developers and partners can build upon, coupled with our own best-in-class applications that showcase what's possible when you reimagine security from the ground up.

Backed by Iconiq Capital, Bessemer Venture Partners, Foundry Capital, and Tiger Global, we're helping Fortune 500 companies and government agencies discover that true data security means having the freedom to share, collaborate, and innovate — without compromise.

Compensation: $150,000-165,000/year

About Varda

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Xaira is an innovative biotech startup focused on leveraging AI to transform drug discovery and development. jobs.title: Channel Marketing Associate
jobs.description_text:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

In this role, you will lead the development and execution of network participation agreement strategies that expand access for the independent primary care practices we serve and advance our mission of value-based care. You will build senior-level payer relationships grounded in trust, negotiate complex agreements to secure optimal network access and favorable terms, and lead a team of talented contracting managers who turn strategy into signed agreements that drive sustainable growth for our practices, our payer partners, and the patients and communities they care for. We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home within the US or be based from Bethesda, MD office. Primary Duties: Aledade offers the following comprehensive total rewards package designed for the overall well-being of our team members: Base salary range: $157,000 – $213,000 USD annually The range above reflects the base pay we reasonably expect to offer for this role across all U.S. locations. Where an individual offer lands within the range depends on the candidate's skills, relevant experience, qualifications, scope of the role, and internal equity. This role is eligible for an annual performance bonus/incentive and equity compensation in addition to the benefits listed below.

jobs.title: Growth Development Representative
jobs.description_text: The Growth Development Representative (GDR) drives Aledade's cohort-driven 1:many demand motion at the account level for Core accounts. Operating as an embedded member of a regional sales pod, the GDR exercises independent judgment to own account engagement strategy across an assigned book of accounts, execute cohort sales plays in partnership with Marketing and Network Development, and lead buying-group qualification and discovery in support of opportunity creation. The role requires substantive decision-making across account prioritization, outreach strategy, stakeholder mapping, and qualification with limited day-to-day oversight, and serves as Aledade's primary entry point for commercial talent into Network Development, Marketing, and Practice Transformation. We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home across US time zones. Wage Range: $24.00 - $28.85 per hour, plus monthly commission and equity Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience.

jobs.title: Manager, Business Compliance (Remote)
jobs.description_text: The Business Compliance Manager drives Aledade’s operational compliance strategy, safeguarding the organization through robust vendor risk governance and regulatory alignment. Reporting collaboratively to Business and Corporate Compliance Leadership, this role primarily spearheads Aledade’s Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) program—mitigating vendor risk across the contract lifecycle. Additionally, the Manager serves as the primary liaison for external audits, acts as the Compliance Subject Matter Expert (SME) for business policies and SOPs, and fosters an ethical, compliant culture across all business units. We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home within the US or be based from Bethesda, MD office. Aledade offers the following comprehensive total rewards package designed for the overall well-being of our team members: Base salary range: $111,000 – $150,000 USD annually The range above reflects the base pay we reasonably expect to offer for this role across all U.S. locations. Where an individual offer lands within the range depends on the candidate's skills, relevant experience, qualifications, scope of the role, and internal equity. This role is eligible for an annual performance bonus/incentive and equity compensation in addition to the benefits listed below.

jobs.title: Manager, Shared Services & Process Improvement, Remote
jobs.description_text: The Manager, Shared Services & Process Improvement designs, improves, and documents the processes that run across the People Team, so that work is done once, done the same way, and done in the right place. Working with People Operations, HRIS, Benefits, Leave, and ADA, Employee Relations, Talent, Learning and Development, and the business partners, this role maps how work flows today, recommends what to automate, support with AI, redesign, or stop, and drives approved changes through to adoption. As the first process improvement hire, this role is the prerequisite to a longer-term automation roadmap for the People Team, which maps People Team work to automation, skill-building, AI agents, and eventually fully autonomous processes. It works from a prioritized improvement backlog set with People leadership, defines the service measures that show whether changes are working, and designs the shared services model, including the rotation that gives entry-level team members a path into other People Team roles. The role also directs and develops the Shared Services team as its formal people manager, and coaches the early-career team members who rotate through it. It is expected to use Aledade's approved AI tooling to speed up process mapping, documentation, and analysis, with human review of all output. The role needs to be excited to join a fast-paced startup with significant opportunity for growth and make a positive contribution to the healthcare field.

jobs.title: Network Development Sales Lead
jobs.description_text: As a Network Development Lead (NDL), you’ll drive Aledade’s growth by recruiting independent primary care practices into value-based care. You’ll be an empathetic, consultative expert who helps physicians understand how Aledade’s expertise, support, and technology can improve patient outcomes and practice sustainability. You’ll own an annual growth target in your core market. You’ll manage the full sales cycle, from prospecting to signed participation agreements. You’ll also partner with field teams and contribute to regional strategy.

jobs.title: Operations and AI Enablement Manager, Remote
jobs.description_text: The Operations and AI Enablement Manager leads the Enterprise Performance enablement team and oversees the day-to-day operational needs of the practices it supports. This role manages a group of Enablement Specialists, setting their priorities, developing their skills, and holding the team accountable for the operating cadence, AI-enabled workflows, and project execution that drive value-based care performance. The Manager supports all Lines of Business (LOB) the team engages in, including Medicare Advantage, MSSP, Medicaid, and Commercial value-based care contracts. The Manager balances people leadership with hands-on operational ownership, resolving practice needs as they arise, removing blockers for the team, and translating executive priorities into repeatable systems that scale.

jobs.title: Practice Transformation Specialist, Florida Panhandle
jobs.description_text: Join Aledade as a Practice Transformation Specialist (PTS) and personally make an impact on patient care. Practice Transformation Specialists are HQ’s most direct interface with providers and can glean valuable insight into our partner practice’s happiness and needs. A successful PTS is passionate about population health, and highly mission oriented around providing better care to patients while reducing costs. At Aledade, a PTS can impact the health of their community by transforming one practice at a time. Note on Travel: On-site check-ins are key. You can expect to travel in-person approximately 1x per month per practice (expected in the Florida panhandle). Exact schedules flex based on practice needs, meaning some months may be lighter or heavier than others.

jobs.description_text: The Regional Medical Director (RMD) is the clinical leader for an assigned portfolio of Aledade markets and serves as the Market’s primary clinical translator. Lead and drive Performance Excellence clinical outcomes across all Market contracts within your portfolio. Strategically align and coordinate with Market Leadership on Performance Excellence clinical drivers of shared savings aligned with the Aledade Annual Operating Plan, including but not limited to driving clinical performance in Risk and Hypertensive-based initiatives, while assisting in the launch of newly signed practices. In coordination with the Market ED, align on goals and objectives and deploy resources including but not limited to clinical coaching, and Aledade tools to drive successful clinical outcomes across the market. At Aledade PBC, you will be part of a creative culture that is driven by a passion for tackling complex issues with respect, open-mindedness and a desire to learn. You will collaborate with team members who bring a wide range of experiences, interests, backgrounds, beliefs and achievements to their work - and who are all united by a shared passion for public health and a commitment to the Aledade mission. jobs.title: Senior Director, VBC Transformation, Remote
jobs.description_text: The Senior Director, VBC Transformation will lead cross-functional operational initiatives across Provider Networks to drive effective construction and deployment of the subject matter expert (SME) function in our Enterprise organization. This new SME function includes a group of specialized individuals that interface with account leadership to drive improvement in value-based care performance. This leadership role encompasses strategic oversight of the new SME function while managing day-to-day operations ensure that we achieve our profit and loss targets for the Enterprise market. The Senior Director will be responsible for deploying SMEs to accounts, delivering executive reporting, and cross-collaboration with departments within and outside of Provider Networks. ASSEMBLY TECHNICIAN (STARSHIP)

The Components team develops the most advanced spacecraft and launch vehicle components in the world. Our technicians serve as hardware build and test experts for a variety of compensator designs that are integrated into both Starship and Super Heavy Booster propulsion systems. This position will include laser welding components, mechanical assembly, and pressure testing large components in a fast paced environment. 

As a technician, you will be responsible for maintaining a high standard of build quality, ensuring tests are being run correctly, and interfacing directly with engineers on the floor. Technicians in this role will be capable of understanding component functionality to be able to assist in troubleshooting or recognizing potential hazards/issues before they occur and helping to update work instructions/processes to reduce future issues and increase personnel safety.
